title: Semantic Search reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong solution for Semantic Search should meet the objective: Build a small document retrieval experiment with toy vectors or text matches; compare relevant results and record one failure of the similarity measure. It should preserve a repeatable test setup, document its assumptions, and distinguish measured results from hypotheses.
explanation: Review the reasoning, not only the required words: inspect whether the test design matches the objective, the result is reproducible, and limitations are reported honestly.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
